value.rationale: This exact full-distribution relation connects two central ecological sampling indicators even with unequal species masses, extends to finite simple random samples, and identifies why higher multiplicity conditioning cannot obey the same universal comparison. Stronger than an expectation bound and provides actionable tail bounds for richness conditioned on a focal singleton; does not imply empirical detection-biased sampling results.
